name: Yang Kyung-won
bio: Yang Kyung-won is a South Korean actor and model. He is best known for his roles in Crash Landing on You, Arthdal Chronicles Part 1: The Children of Prophecy and Hi Bye, Mama!.

credits.title: Sori: Voice from the Heart
credits.overview: While desperately searching for his missing daughter, Hae-kwan comes across an AI satellite robot that remembers sounds from all over the world. Rejuvenated by the robot's abilities, Hae-kwan begins to track down his daughter's voice. As they continue their journey, they form an unforgettable bond.
